definitions: The cavity in human beings and animals where sound produced at the sound source (larynx in mammals; syrinx in birds) is filtered.
The system of cavities and organs (such as the pharynx, mouth, and nasal cavity) above the larynx in which the sound produced by the vocal cords is modified to produce speech sounds.
examples: The shape of the vocal tract changes during speech.
Air passes through the vocal tract.
Different languages use the vocal tract in unique ways.
